title: LEGO Icons 11387 Holiday House joins the Winter Village Collection
summary: LEGO has officially revealed 11387 Holiday House, a new 1,354-piece addition to the Winter Village Collection, arriving 1 October with an RRP of £99.99.
bodyMarkdown:
## What happened
LEGO has officially unveiled 11387 Holiday House, the newest set to join the long-running Icons Winter Village Collection. The 1,354-piece build includes a light brick and depicts a snowy holiday home with a wrap-around porch, bay windows, and a festively decorated facade complete with garland, golden bells and holly.

Inside, builders get cosy antique-style furnishings such as a fireplace, gramophone, rotary phone and mantel clock, alongside festive touches like candy canes, presents, stockings and a pumpkin pie. A Christmas tree can be placed inside and lit up via the included light brick, glowing through the windows on both floors. The set also comes with a horse-drawn sleigh, a snowman, four minifigures and a horse.

11387 Holiday House goes on general release from 1 October 2026, priced at £99.99 in the UK (US $119.99 / CAN $169.99). It includes 3D digital instructions via the LEGO Builder app, with a Build Together feature for collaborative building.

## Why it matters
The Winter Village Collection is a firm favourite among AFOLs and seasonal display builders, and each new entry adds fresh display and lighting options for festive layouts. For UK collectors and Bricks in a Bag customers building winter scenes, this set offers another compatible-friendly centrepiece to expand village displays ahead of Christmas.

## What to watch next
Keep an eye out for early reviews and piece-count breakdowns once the set releases on 1 October, plus any retailer promotions in the run-up to the festive season.

title: Lumibricks reviews in: Neon Elite Lounge and Neon Garden shine (mostly)
summary: Brick Fanatics has reviewed Lumibricks' latest cyberpunk sets, the Neon Elite Lounge and Neon Garden, praising the light integration but flagging a rough minifigure-building experience.
bodyMarkdown:
## What happened
Brick Fanatics has published a review of two new sets from compatible brick brand Lumibricks: the Neon Elite Lounge and the Neon Garden. Both are part of Lumibricks' cyberpunk collection and are designed to be displayed together, adding more greenery to the cyberpunk city theme than previous sets. The Neon Elite Lounge is the larger of the pair, going for a denser but shorter build than is typical for the range.

The review awarded the sets 6/10 overall, with a breakdown of 9/10 for design, 7/10 for playability, 8/10 for value, 2/10 for minifigures, and 6/10 for build. Reviewers highlighted the light integration as a standout feature, along with a detailed and accessible interior and other unique elements beyond the lighting. On the downside, the review criticised a fiddly light installation process, a poor figure-building experience, and noted that some of the best details end up hidden with no way to access them.

For fans who enjoy display builds, city dioramas, or lighting techniques, this pairing could be a notable addition to a collection — provided you're prepared for a tricky light install and underwhelming figures.

title: LEGO Icons 11387 Holiday House Joins the Winter Village Collection
summary: LEGO has officially revealed 11387 Holiday House, a 1,354-piece addition to the much-loved Winter Village Collection, landing on LEGO.com from 1st October.
bodyMarkdown:
## What happened
LEGO has officially unveiled 11387 Holiday House, the newest set in the LEGO Icons Winter Village Collection. Aimed at adult builders, the 1,354-piece model brings a snug, snow-covered home to life with pitched roofs, a wrap-around porch, bay windows and cross-latticed glazing.

The facade is finished with festive touches including a garland, golden bells and sprigs of holly, while the interior is packed with antique-style furnishings such as a fireplace, gramophone, rotary phone and mantel clock.

The set is rated 18+ and will be available from LEGO.com starting 1st October, priced at $119.99 / £99.99 / €109.99.

Interestingly, this launch comes alongside a new Hallowe'en-themed building series, but LEGO has confirmed the classic Winter Village Collection continues alongside it.

## Why it matters
The Winter Village Collection has become a firm favourite among UK AFOLs (Adult Fans of LEGO) for seasonal display building, and each new release tends to sell out quickly once winter approaches. For anyone building a festive display shelf, stadium-style village layout, or simply adding to a growing collection, this is a confirmed, buildable addition worth planning ahead for.

## What to watch next
Watch for early UK reviews and piece-count breakdowns once the set lands on shelves from 1st October, plus any early stock or price movement given past demand for Winter Village releases.
